heading: Welcome to Riverside
intro: You have arrived in a village on the edge of the Whispering Woods. Something is stirring beyond its gates, but the square is safe enough to get your bearings. Pick any path below; none closes off the others.

objectives.instruction: Get oriented: read your surroundings and the available exits
Help Riverside: inspect the board, then gather at the community garden west and south
Trade and prepare: visit Talia at the market by going east twice
Explore and face danger: equip your rusty dagger, then take the north road to the woods
